positions.as_written: Take the history: the medial pain, the duration, the walking distance and whether the leg shape has changed.
Assess the correctability by applying a valgus force with the knee near extension and recording how far the alignment improves.
Assess the lateral collateral ligament, since a long standing varus knee stretches the lateral structures.
Measure the range, recording the fixed flexion separately, since varus knees commonly lose extension.
